hookups.source: https://www.gafreshwatercamping.com/hester-s-ferry-site ('Sites 1-16 are equipped with water and electrical hook-ups (30-amp and a few 50-amp). A separate loop has 10 primitive sites.'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Sites 1-16 have water and electric (30-amp, a few 50-amp); sites 17-26 are a separate primitive loop. Firefly classes: RV Site - Standard, RV Site - Water Access, Primitive Campsite.

sites.source: https://www.gafreshwatercamping.com/hester-s-ferry-site ('the 26 shaded campsites on the lake') + Firefly class filter, read 2026-10-29

values.note: Booked through the lessee's Firefly page (linked as 'CHECK AVAILABILITY / BOOK NOW!'), or by a reservation inquiry a camp host answers by the next morning. Firefly: 'One site per person - if booking multiple sites, you will need to book each individually with a different name on each reservation.'

note: USACE Savannah District campground on J. Strom Thurmond (Clarks Hill) Lake at Fishing Creek, run by a lessee (Georgia Freshwater Campgrounds), 1880 Hester's Ferry Rd, Tignall. The lessee: 'All the sites in Hester's Ferry are on the water.' Federal land. --Claude
summary: Lessee's own page (gafreshwatercamping.com) and its Firefly booking page: confirmed 26 sites, water + electric 30/50-amp on sites 1-16, lakefront. Changed booking platform reserveamerica -> operator (Firefly deep link; the old note said neither RA nor rec.gov lists it). Note trimmed of hookups/counts and the undated Explore Georgia $27. Sewer false and dump left as stored (page silent). No fees: Firefly's unit search needs reCAPTCHA and the operator posts only 'Campsite prices vary depending on type site and location'.
flags: Website is the USACE camping page (now returns 403); the lessee's own page is https://www.gafreshwatercamping.com/hester-s-ferry-site, which links the Firefly booking page.

No 2024+ rate: Firefly prices only through a reCAPTCHA-gated search (headless browser refused), the lessee posts no rates, and Explore Georgia's $27 water/electric and $15 primitive are undated. The lessee also lists a 'Daily Pass for Campgrounds $5.00' (unclear whether campers pay it).
Phone: the lessee's site gives only 800-405-1033 (stored, company-wide); Google lists a local 706-359-2746 for the campground.
